slot: Terms of service, privacy policy, cookie consent

pick.name: Common Paper ToS + vanilla-cookieconsent
pick.what: Free click-through ToS; MIT cookie-banner library only if non-essential cookies are used
pick.why: Free, no per-site fees; cookieless analytics avoid banners in many cases

alts.name: Termly
alts.what: Hosted policy generator, consent banner, scanner
alts.free_limits: Free: 1 policy, banner 10k views/mo; Starter USD 10/mo/site

decision: Use Common Paper's ToS, draft each privacy policy from the real data flows, and get one lawyer review. Choose cookieless analytics so no banner is needed; add a consent library only for ad pixels. Move to iubenda if keeping policies current becomes a chore.

region_notes.EU: ePrivacy/GDPR require prior consent for non-essential cookies.
region_notes.UK: UK PECR mirrors EU cookie rules.
region_notes.US: California and other states require notice and opt-out for selling/sharing data.
region_notes.India: DPDP Rules require a standalone notice and consent for personal data (core duties from 13 May 2027).
